key_highlights: ASX slides as oil nears US$100/bbl amid Iran-US conflict; rate hike bets intensify, big four banks fall
RBA faces recession-vs-inflation dilemma; business conditions weakest since pandemic
Iron ore in structural decline; China patience with Trump eroding, pressuring BHP/RIO/FMG
WA gold sector active: Auric, Golden Dragon, Forrestania, Gateway all advancing projects
Austal jumps on US$1.9b bid; Qantas fires workers with $35m payout
Coal strike at WA energy grid; NSW power shortfall risk; data centres strain energy transition
Home buyer sentiment collapses; NZ house crash echoes Australian housing concerns
Santos gas cartel scrutiny; Chevron record run continues on energy strength

sectors.trend: Iron ore in structural downtrend; copper and gold counter-cyclical strength. Flagship expanding copper; WA gold juniors active. China demand softening.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face headwinds from iron ore weakness and China tensions. Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) and copper (STO.AX, FLAG.AX) offer relative strength. WA gold juniors (Auric, Golden Dragon, Forrestania, Gateway) show sector rotation into precious metals.

sectors.trend: Big four banks under pressure from rate hike fears and recession risk. Credit cycle turning. Qantas $35m payout signals corporate stress.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin compression if RBA hikes into recession. NIMs may widen but credit losses rise. Defensive positioning warranted.

sectors.trend: Oil near US$100 on Iran conflict; Santos under scrutiny; coal strike threatens WA grid; data centres demand power. Chevron record run continues.
sectors.implications: SOL.AX, WDS.AX, CGX.AX benefit from oil spike. Coal (WES.AX, STO.AX) faces strike risk but data centre demand supports pricing. Energy transition narrative challenged by AI power demand.

sectors.trend: Business conditions weakest since pandemic; home buyer sentiment collapses; Qantas restructuring; 102-year-old mall retailer closing 25 stores.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WBC.AX, LPX.AX face demand softness. Austal (AUS.AX) bid at US$1.9b is positive catalyst. Consumer discretionary under pressure.

sectors.trend: AI data centre boom straining energy supply; SLB $4.1bn bet; power giants positioning coal sites for data centres. Evercore warns on AI IPOs.
sectors.implications: ASX-listed data centre and infrastructure plays benefit. Energy transition narrative disrupted. Watch for power constraint risks to project timelines.

key_themes: Geopolitical oil shock: Iran-US conflict pushing oil to US$100, fueling inflation and rate hike fears
RBA policy trap: recession risk vs sticky energy-driven inflation
Iron ore structural decline with China demand weakening
Gold and copper rotation as safe-haven and industrial demand diverge
Energy transition vs AI data centre power demand tension
Australian business and housing sentiment at cyclical lows

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price spike and geopolitical escalation (Iran-US)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour oil producers (SOL.AX, CGX.AX) over refiners; monitor Hormuz shipping

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA forced into recessionary rate path
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce cyclical exposure; favour dividend-paying defensives; monitor RBA statement for forward guidance

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand collapse / China slowdown
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold and copper

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy supply disruption (coal strike, NSW shortfall)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor WES.AX, STO.AX strike outcomes; data centre project delays possible
Reduce REIT and consumer discretionary exposure; watch retail sales data

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight oil and gas producers on US$100 oil
opportunities.rationale: Iran conflict sustains elevated oil; Chevron record run validates sector strength; Santos underpriced post-cartel scrutiny

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate into WA gold juniors and senior gold names
opportunities.rationale: Multiple WA gold projects advancing (Auric, Golden Dragon, Forrestania, Gateway); safe-haven demand on geopolitical risk

opportunities.recommendation: Position in copper on structural supply-demand gap
opportunities.rationale: Flagship expanding Canadian copper; red metal soars on energy transition and AI data centre demand

opportunities.recommendation: Austal bid creates short-term trading opportunity
opportunities.rationale: US$1.9b bid provides price floor; shipbuilding sector undervalued

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and cyclical mining exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore in structural decline; China demand weakening; 'drowning not waving'

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim big four bank positions ahead of RBA decision
defensive_moves.rationale: Rate hike into recession compresses equity multiples; credit cycle turning
Business conditions weakest since pandemic; recession risk elevated; preserve capital
Home buyer sentiment collapse; retail weakness; mall closures signal structural shift

market_outlook.short_term: ASX under pressure: oil at US$100 fuels rate hike bets, banks fall, iron ore weak. RBA policy trap dominates. Expect volatility around RBA decision and Iran conflict escalation. Gold and energy outperform; banks and iron ore lag.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural shift: iron ore decline, AI data centre power demand reshaping energy mix, gold/copper rotation. Australian business conditions at cyclical trough suggest mean-reversion potential within 12 months if RBA pivots. Housing correction may extend. China-US tensions add uncertainty.
